_comment: Score values for Pokemon Pinball+. All values are plain integers, converted to BCD internally.

common._comment: Common score values used across both fields

mewtwo_bonus._comment_orb: Points for hitting an orbiting ball

jackpots._comment: Jackpot accumulation values for catch and evolution modes
jackpots._comment_catch_voltorb: Added to jackpot when all Voltorb tiles flipped during catch mode
jackpots._comment_catch_spinner: Added to jackpot per spinner hit during catch mode
jackpots._comment_catch_bellsprout: Added to jackpot per Bellsprout hit during catch mode
jackpots._comment_evo_voltorb: Added to jackpot when all Voltorb tiles flipped during evolution mode
jackpots._comment_evo_bellsprout: Added to jackpot per Bellsprout hit during evolution mode
jackpots._comment_evo_spinner: Added to jackpot per spinner hit during evolution mode
